episodes.title: Maine's highest court denies mother's appeal of order that stops her from taking daughter to church
episodes.description:
The legal organization representing Emily Bickford says it will ask the U.S. Supreme Court to take up the case and overrule the decision made by the Maine Supreme Judicial Court.
